CustomField.label: Current Run Id
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Unique identifier for the currently tracked PrivacyGuard masking run.
CustomField.description: Set by AutomationManagerService.disableAllAutomations() when Use_Metadata_Deactivation__c is enabled, so enableAllAutomations() (running in a later, separate transaction) knows which Deactivated_Automation__c records to restore.
